notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 0.4.1
notes.content:
[h1]📘 Tutorial & Manual[/h1]
[list]
[*] Updated tutorial
[*] Implemented in-depth manual
[*] New menu item featuring most in-game topics with detailed information
[/list]

[h1]🏗️ New Buildings & Features[/h1]
[h2]New Buildings:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Droid Core Facility
[*] Droid Assembly
[/list]
[h2]New Feature: Droids![/h2]
[list]
[*] Use Droid Cores (aka Blue Cores)
[/list]

[h1]🎨 Cosmetics & Environment[/h1]
Cosmetics:
[list]
[*] New cosmetic: Golden Bot Statue
[*] New cosmetic: Trees
[/list]
Environment:
[list]
[*] Trees can now be destroyed and replanted
[*] Bushes can be deleted when building over them
[/list]

[h1]🎨 Paint & Resource Production[/h1]
Paint production system implemented
Dye Mixer building added
[list]
[*] Blue paint recipe: Blue Pigment + Oil
[/list]
Buildings now effectively produce pigment

[h1]🛢️ New Resources & Map Update[/h1]
Oil rig and Oil resource added
Updated map with:
[list]
[*] More Polyrock
[*] More Oil resources
[/list]

[h1]🚜 Harvesting & Storage[/h1]
[h2]Harvester Pad:[/h2]
[list]
[*] New larger model
[*] Has internal storage
[*] Now appears on corners of building platforms
[*] It’s Faster! 
[/list]

[h1]👷 Operators & UX Enhancements[/h1]
[h2]Operators:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Counter operator added
[*] Scrapper added
[*] Stamper UX overhaul
[*] Inside operator animations
[*] Speed indications added to operator views
[*] Hovering shows visual representation of operator internals
[*] Shortcuts for rotating operators + inverse rotation
[*] Assembler, stamper and cutter are now color agnostic 
[/list]

[h2]Efficiency View:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Highlights and color codes operators based on their efficiency
[/list]

[h2]Cutter Operator:[/h2]
[list]
[*] No longer starts with default configuration (requires input like others)
[/list]

[h1]🏢 Buildings & Module Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Deposited modules are retained when upgrading a building
[*] Max module size locked to 16x16
[/list]

[h1]🖱️ User Experience (UX) Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Resource nodes highlighted when placing extractors
[*] Visual indicator of blocked tiles in build mode
[*] Tilt-shift effect can now be toggled on/off
[/list]

[h1]🎨 Art & UI Updates[/h1]
[list]
[*] Animations added to all operators
[*] Operator models and VFX updated
[*] Higher resolution textures for building icons
[*] New thumbnails for all operators
[*] Subtle building texturing improvements
[*] New narrator portrait
[*] New smoke VFX
[/list]
[h2]UI:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Objectives UI overhaul
[*] Toolbar UI update
[/list]

[h1]⚙️ Performance Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Performance slightly improved, especially with many operators on screen
[/list]

[h1]🔤 Localization[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added Japanese
[*] Fixed multiple localization issues with several languages in the game
[/list]

[h1]🐞 Bug Fixes [/h1]

[h2]🖼️ Visual Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Dye Mixer now shows “producing liquid” animation
[*] Output shapes in the Cutter now show correctly (not flipped)
[*] Fixed visualization of delivery dock model in demo build
[*] Fixed incorrect boundaries for Basic Bot Factory (Small)
[*] Fixed chasm rendering issue when placing conveyor belts
[/list]

[h2]🖱️ UI Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Building upgrade text now displays correctly
[*] Tooltips no longer appear over modals or inside operators
[*] Operator status UI hidden correctly inside Cutter view
[*] Hovering over Polyrocks and side toolbar now shows tooltips
[*] Correct number of resources now shown when moving buildings with selected recipe
[*] Side toolbar and pin-all option now behave correctly
[*] Cutters and other operator views have correct rotation shortcuts
[*] Missing loca keys fixed for all buildings
[*] Basic Core Facility popup shows correct requirements
[*] Playtime displays correctly on save screen and pause menu
[/list]

[h2]🧠 Logic & Functionality Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where game gets stuck on "Upgrade Building" quest
[*] "Upgrade a building" onboarding quest now completes properly
[*] Cranes no longer get deleted when moving buildings
[*] Factory no longer stops when moving core processing buildings
[*] Moving items through tunnels is no longer instant
[*] Cutter now requires proper configuration to work and be duplicated
[*] Fixed crash when Cutter has 4 different outputs
[*] Cutter no longer outputs modules with invalid input
[*] Assembler no longer triggers wrong warning icon
[*] Player can no longer move out of bounds using WASD
[*] Camera movement and ESC key behavior restored in various menus
[*] Tech tree button no longer breaks toolbar or camera
[*] Fix for hub disappearing when saving with "v" in the name
[*] Fixed NullReference errors when clicking objectives or during cloud-related functions
[*] Fixed tooltip behavior on depots and other UI elements
[*] Fixed inconsistencies in throughput between Assembler and Cutter
[*] Harvester Pad can no longer be placed incorrectly via mirroring
[/list]

[h2]📚 Localization (LOCA) Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed missing ‘s’ in mission description (splitting conveyor)
[*] Fixed confusing naming (Basic Bots/Droids vs Grey/Blue bots)
[*] General localization issues across UI elements, buildings, and quests resolved
[/list]
